title: Rate limit report creation per owner
body:
**What**

Adds a simple per-owner rate limit to `POST /reports`: an owner making more than 30 create requests within a 60-second window gets a 429 response.

**Why**

A misbehaving integration hammered the create endpoint in a loop last week and filled one owner's report list with thousands of near-duplicate rows before anyone noticed. A basic per-owner limit catches that class of bug without needing a real rate-limiting service in front of a service this small.
